The current-head native run rebuilt `b29dbb8` and passed **2,320 Core tests, zero failures, zero skips**, plus native rendering/export, desktop, package verification, installer lifecycle and [installed Flowchart authoring](https://github.com/DouglasNLima/local-docs-studio/actions/runs/42624169730/job/129199599927). Its two conditional skips are the original `.853` diagnostic replay and historical upgrade. Both Pages deployment jobs were skipped.

Current Continuous 250 ms acceptance remains **INCOMPLETE / FAIL**, with **28** and **31** failed candidate samples. The [original provenance FAIL](https://github.com/DouglasNLima/local-docs-studio/actions/runs/42616164670), [original Continuous failures (28/27)](https://github.com/DouglasNLima/local-docs-studio/actions/runs/42616165018), earlier failures, logs and metadata remain preserved without reclassification. The historical records match the original evidence byte-for-byte. No hosted run was retried, and no check was waived or retired.

The original unsigned internal `0.1.1-preview.1055` remains attributed to source `3a8f10d737791a1182d092676ecb17a47e2fde30`, tree `1f13a1afa64fd0b4419303bcaf0136f1ffcecfe7`:

Hosted #1056 outputs are separate CI artefacts from the new head; they do not replace or relabel `.1055`. The original packages were not rebuilt, installed, signed, distributed or republished during this correction.

The remaining integration blockers are the protected native/test byte conflicts and failed Continuous acceptance. Resolving the former requires a separately authorised change to implementation/test integration or provenance governance; this request explicitly preserves both. PR #81 remains **Draft**. PRs #76/#78/#80 remain unchanged and Draft; #76 remains NO-GO. Goal #77, ADR 007, the 250 ms gate, the 4.5:1 requirement and release restrictions remain unchanged. No merge, official release, package signing, deployment or distribution.
